verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Supabase data-export capability. Daily backups (supabase-docs-11) are not described as downloadable or in an open format. Standard Postgres connections (supabase-docs-20) are only a building block a user could use to dump data themselves. Docker self-hosting (supabase-docs-6) is a deployment option, not an export path, and the migration guide covers moving data into Supabase, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
